action: On the Manual account #1 reports page, open Search and type "Supermarket".
expectedStateChange: The transaction list shows only the Supermarket row; the other three account #1 rows are hidden.

action: On Manual account #1 reports, open Search and type a label that matches nothing, "zzz-no-match".
expectedStateChange: The transaction list has no rows and shows the empty-result message.

action: On Manual account #1 reports, click "Add a transaction", enter label "Bench pharmacy" and amount -12.40, then submit.
expectedStateChange: The list gains a "Bench pharmacy" row (five rows in total), and the account #1 balance falls from 1 172,20 € to 1 159,80 €.

action: Open the transaction details for "Rent September" on account #1 and change its Category from Housing to Groceries.
expectedStateChange: The Category select reads Groceries, and the "Rent September" row in the account #1 list shows Groceries.

action: Open the transaction details for "Employer payroll" on account #1 and change its Type from Transfer to Deposit.
expectedStateChange: The Type select reads Deposit, and the stored transaction type is type.deposit.

action: Open the transaction details for "Supermarket" on account #1, replace the Custom label with "Weekly shop", and save it.
expectedStateChange: The account #1 list shows "Weekly shop" where "Supermarket" was, and the Supermarket label is no longer shown.

action: Open the transaction details for "Metro pass" on account #1 and click "Delete this transaction".
expectedStateChange: The account #1 list drops from four rows to three and no longer contains "Metro pass".

action: Open the transaction details for "Rent September" on account #1 and click "Create auto-categorization rule".
expectedStateChange: The rules list gains one rule for the Rent September label, where it previously had none.

action: On the Categories page, click "Add a category", enter the name "Pets" and save.
expectedStateChange: The categories table gains a Pets row, so it lists five categories instead of four.

action: On the Categories page, rename the Groceries category to "Food".
expectedStateChange: The categories table shows Food in place of Groceries, and the text Groceries is no longer in the table.

action: On the Categories page, click "Add default categories".
expectedStateChange: The categories table lists more than the four seeded categories (Groceries, Housing, Salary, Transport).

action: On the Budget page for Manual account #1, click the Plus button of the Groceries row, enter a planned budget of 300, and confirm.
expectedStateChange: The Groceries row's sign button reads Minus with 300 in its planned budget field, and the Total planned budget changes from 0.00 to -300.00.

action: On the Charts page for Manual account #1, click the "Last year" period button.
expectedStateChange: The period field changes from the current month's range to the previous calendar year's range (01/01 to 12/31 of that year).

action: On the Charts page for Manual account #1, select the "balance" chart tab.
expectedStateChange: The URL changes to #/view/account/1/charts/balance and the balance tab is the selected one.

action: On the Views settings page, click "Create a view", enter the name "Household", select Manual account #1 and Manual account #2, and save.
expectedStateChange: The Custom views list in the menu and on the page shows Household, where it previously showed "You have no custom views yet."

action: On the Recurring transactions page for Manual account #1, create a recurring transaction labelled "Gym" with amount -30.00 and a monthly frequency.
expectedStateChange: The recurring transactions list for account #1 gains a Gym row.

action: On the Auto categorization page, click "New rule", set the condition label contains "Metro" and the action category Transport, then save.
expectedStateChange: The rules list changes from "You haven't set any rules yet!" to a list with one rule.

action: On the Bank accesses page, edit the Manual Bank access and rename it to "Bench bank".
expectedStateChange: The menu access entry and the page header show Bench bank in place of Manual Bank.

action: On the Bank accesses page, edit Manual account #3 and set its custom label to "Savings wallet".
expectedStateChange: The menu entry for the third account reads Savings wallet in place of Manual account #3.

action: From the menu on the dashboard, open Manual account #2.
expectedStateChange: The URL changes to #/view/account/2/... and the side menu marks the Manual account #2 entry as the active one.

action: From the menu, open the EUR global view.
expectedStateChange: The URL changes to #/view/currency/EUR/... and the page lists the transactions of all accounts in EUR, with the Total of 1 072,20 € shown.

action: On the Customization settings page, switch the language selector to Français.
expectedStateChange: The menu section names are shown in French, so Reports is shown as Relevé.

action: On the transaction details for "Rent September" on account #1, set the Budget month to Previous.
expectedStateChange: The Budget month button group marks Previous as selected, where no month was selected before.
